Primary product page and ONC mandatory disclosures for SecureEMR+. Lists core features: practice management, telemedicine, integrated billing, patient portal, referral management, eRX, interoperability, population health, productivity tools. Describes it as the most comprehensive EMR in Puerto Rico.

Company overview: 20+ years in sector, 15,000+ customers, 300+ specialties, products include SecureClaim, SecureTrack, SecureEMR/SecureEMR+, SecureInsight. All cloud-based. Partners with major PR insurers.

May 2021 partnership announcement. SecureEMR+ is derived from the union of Inmediata (billing/connectivity via SecureClaim and SecureiOS) and PrognoCIS (clinical EMR by Bizmatics Inc.). ONC certified April 23, 2021.

Company profile: founded by Severiano Lopez-Marrero, San Juan PR. SecureClaim handles billing from intake through reimbursement. Dominates 80%+ of PR dental claims. Expansion plans to FL, TX, AZ, NM, and Latin America. Office in Charlotte, NC.

PrognoCIS reviews: 4/5 stars from 118 reviews. Features include customizable templates, smart phrases, integrated billing, patient portal, e-prescribing, telehealth. Supports cardiology, dermatology, family medicine, internal medicine, psychiatry. Users praise ease of use but note support delays and 5MB upload limit.

PrognoCIS (by Bizmatics) main site. Cloud-based EHR with practice management, billing, telemedicine, eRx (including controlled substances), patient portal. Developed since 2001. Used in ambulatory clinics.
